name: esp_audio_player_service_get_status
description: Get playback state, position, duration, and volume for one stream (default stream 0)

name: esp_audio_player_service_set_output_volume
description: Set service-wide DAC/output volume (0-100)

name: esp_audio_player_service_get_output_volume
description: Get service-wide DAC/output volume (0-100)

name: esp_audio_player_service_set_volume
description: Set per-stream playback volume via ALC (0-100)

name: esp_audio_player_service_get_volume
description: Get per-stream playback volume (0-100)

name: esp_audio_player_service_set_url
description: Set the URL/source for a stream (file:/// http(s):// or HLS). Does not start playback by itself

name: esp_audio_player_service_play
description: Start or restart playback on a stream

name: esp_audio_player_service_pause
description: Pause playback on a stream

name: esp_audio_player_service_resume
description: Resume a paused stream

name: esp_audio_player_service_stop
description: Stop playback on a stream (source is kept)

name: esp_audio_player_service_seek
description: Seek a URL-path stream to an absolute position in milliseconds

name: esp_audio_player_service_set_speed
description: Set playback speed multiplier (1.0 is normal)

name: esp_audio_player_service_playlist_next
description: Play the next playlist item on a stream (requires an attached playlist)

name: esp_audio_player_service_playlist_prev
description: Play the previous playlist item on a stream (requires an attached playlist)

name: esp_audio_player_service_playlist_play_index
description: Play the playlist item at the given zero-based index

name: esp_audio_player_service_set_repeat_mode
description: Set playlist repeat mode: none, one, or all

name: esp_audio_player_service_set_mix_cfg
description: Set per-stream mix priority and preemption policy (before first play). Same priority streams coexist; higher priority can duck (coexist) or exclusive-preempt

active_gain.description: Linear mixer gain when not suppressed; default 1.0

duck_gain.description: Linear mixer gain when ducked; default 0.2

transition_ms.description: Fade time between gains in ms; default 200

name: esp_audio_player_service_get_preempt_state
description: Query whether a stream is currently EXCLUSIVE-preempted

name: esp_audio_player_service_enable_id3_parse
description: Enable or disable ID3 parsing for bare .mp3 sources on a stream (call before play)

name: esp_audio_player_service_get_id3_info
description: Get ID3 title/author/album for the current MP3 on a stream (after TRACK_INFO_PARSED)
